nodes.name: serviceHelpers.ts
nodes.summary: Shared backend service helper module providing trip/entity access verification, permission-level utilities, Prisma update-payload builders, and Decimal-to-number conversion helpers used across most service modules.
nodes.languageNotes: Centralizes cross-cutting authorization and data-transformation logic (per CLAUDE.md's src/services/_shared/ convention) so individual services avoid duplicating permission-checking and Decimal-conversion code.

nodes.name: verifyEntityInTrip
nodes.summary: Verifies that a given entity belongs to a specific trip, throwing an AppError when it is not found or does not belong to the trip.

nodes.name: verifyEntityAccessById
nodes.summary: Verifies a user has access to an entity looked up by ID, checking that the entity's trip belongs to the requesting user.

nodes.name: verifyTripAccess
nodes.summary: Verifies that a user has access to a given trip, throwing an AppError if the trip is not found or not owned by the user.

nodes.name: isValidPermissionLevel
nodes.summary: Type guard that checks whether an arbitrary value is one of the valid collaboration permission levels.

nodes.name: toSafePermissionLevel
nodes.summary: Safely coerces an arbitrary value to a valid permission level, falling back to a provided default when invalid.

nodes.name: verifyTripAccessWithPermission
nodes.summary: Verifies a user has at least the required permission level on a trip, accounting for ownership and collaborator roles.

nodes.name: verifyEntityAccessWithPermission
nodes.summary: Verifies a user has the required permission level to access a specific entity, delegating to trip-level permission checks.

nodes.name: verifyEntityAccess
nodes.summary: Generic check confirming an already-fetched entity's trip belongs to the requesting user.

nodes.name: buildUpdateData
nodes.summary: Builds a partial Prisma update payload from provided data, omitting fields that are undefined.

nodes.name: buildConditionalUpdateData
nodes.summary: Builds an update payload while applying field-specific transformer functions conditionally based on provided options.

nodes.name: tripDateTransformer
nodes.summary: Transformer helper that normalizes a date string field for trip update payloads.

nodes.name: verifyEntityOwnership
nodes.summary: Confirms a queried entity exists and belongs to the given user by running a lookup query and checking ownership.

nodes.name: convertDecimals
nodes.summary: Recursively converts Prisma Decimal fields to plain JavaScript numbers within an object or array, used before returning data to clients.

nodes.name: cleanupEntityLinks
nodes.summary: Deletes entity-link records referencing a deleted entity within a trip, used for cascade cleanup after entity deletion.

nodes.name: createMockEntityLink
nodes.summary: Test helper factory that builds a mock EntityLink object with sensible overridable default field values for use across the entity-link test suite.
